title_sq: Tek Riverside Residence, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!

title_en: At Riverside Residence, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Regular Layout!!!
description_en: At Riverside Residence, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Regular Layout!!! The property is located on the 2nd floor of a 9-story building. The gross area is 79.72 m2, from which the net area is 65 m2. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The strategic location gives the residence the potential of one of the most developed and accessible areas in Tirana of the future. With an in-residence shopping mall, Riverside Residence offers a modern lifestyle interwoven with employment and full access to services for the entire urban space around it.
